text: Azul Core provides TCK-verified OpenJDK builds, commercial support, quarterly security updates, and legal indemnification. Azul describes it as a one-to-one replacement for Oracle Java SE.
Azul Core is positioned for enterprises needing supported Java runtimes, broad platform coverage, security updates, and long-term support.
Azul Prime is a commercial high-performance Java platform distribution based on OpenJDK, with an enhanced JVM intended for application performance, responsiveness, and efficiency.
Azul states that Platform Prime uses a modified JVM to target lower latency and higher throughput for Java workloads.
Azul Intelligence Cloud uses production Java runtime data to provide JVM and code inventory and to identify unused code.
Intelligence Cloud is positioned for Java estate discovery, Oracle Java migration and compliance, application modernization, and identifying dead or unused code.
